Arpita and I are very close friends. She is an introvert and I am an extrovert, but somehow our minds speak the same language.

Different personalities, similar thoughts, the same kind of madness, and a bond that words could never fully explain. Two souls that think alike, and a friendship that feels effortless.

She tells me every small incident of her day, and I love hearing every bit of it.
